verdict.rationale: The evidence shows 1Password can store one-time passwords (docs-20) and that vaults exist as a CLI scoping concept (docs-2). Nothing in the pack documents sharing vaults or collections across a team, or granting per-member access to them. TOTP storage and vault listing are adjacent features, not the team-sharing and access-control capability the story asks for, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control
